name: power_input_header
summary: DC power input on a 2-pin 2.54 mm header, with the bulk capacitor Espressif recommends at the main power entrance.

sources.document: Espressif ESP32-S3 Hardware Design Guidelines, section 1.3.2 Power Supply
Murata reference sheet GRM21BR61E106KA73-01A (10 uF 25 V X5R 0805)

ports.name: vout
ports.note: the voltage the user states for the external supply; max 25 V because of the capacitor's rating

notes.text: Espressif suggests at least 10 uF at the main power entrance: included (10 uF 25 V X5R).
Espressif also suggests an ESD protection diode at the power entrance. NOT included: the parts library has no ESD diode yet (reported, not dropped).
The capacitor is rated 25 V DC; X5R capacitance falls under DC bias, so the effective value at the supply voltage is less than 10 uF.
